gaps.quote: A counter that moves through the stream computes it
gaps.note: The page uses stream and stream order throughout but never says what the stream is or how records are arranged in it.

gaps.quote: Let $q$ be the address of a record before the move
gaps.note: The page refers to the move as the operation that changes addresses, but never says what the move is.

gaps.quote: the extracted records are sorted by
gaps.note: The page never says how records are extracted or why they are extracted.

gaps.quote: the integers the rectangular routine handles
gaps.note: The page names a rectangular routine but does not explain it or link it to a page.

gaps.quote: Since the move permutes the exceptional addresses
gaps.note: The page does not say which addresses are exceptional or how the move permutes them.

gaps.quote: marks its hole, the position it returns to
gaps.note: A hole is described only as the position a record returns to; the page does not say how holes are chosen or marked.

gaps.quote: on a fixed track of the stream
gaps.note: The page does not explain what a track of the stream is or how a fixed track is fixed.

gaps.quote: The destination rank follows from the current rank by a signed sum over the chunks:
gaps.note: The reader cannot check that the rank changes additively, by sigma_h per unit change in chunk h, from what the page gives; the page only asserts the sum.

gaps.quote: as for chunks with 4 and 3 values
gaps.note: The page does not explain how the strides 1, 4 and 12 follow from the chunk sizes 4 and 3, so the example values cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: the destination ranks are distinct and are exactly the ranks of the marked holes
gaps.note: The claim depends on the move permuting the exceptional addresses and on how holes are marked, neither of which the page explains, so the reader cannot check it.

gaps.term: sorting puts each record in its hole
gaps.quote: Sorting the records by destination rank therefore puts each record into its own hole.
gaps.note: This follows only from the unexplained distinctness and marking claims, so the reader cannot check it from the page.

gaps.quote: The sort runs one pass per bit of the key
gaps.note: The page asserts the number of passes and their link to the width of the rank without showing how the cost bound follows.
